topics.title: Two-Line Element (TLE) Sets & SGP4 Orbital Propagation
topics.objective: Propagate satellite and trackable debris state vectors forward in time using SGP4 perturbation models.
topics.exercise: Compute the Cartesian state vector (r, v) in TEME frame for a cataloged debris object at a 24-hour lookahead epoch.

topics.title: Conjunction Data Message (CDM) Parsing & Covariance Ellipsoids
topics.objective: Ingest CCSDS standard Conjunction Data Messages and reconstruct positional covariance matrices at Time of Closest Approach (TCA).
topics.exercise: Extract the combined 3x3 position covariance matrix and calculate 3-sigma positional uncertainty ellipsoids at TCA.

topics.title: Foster-1992 & Alfriend Probability of Collision (Pc)
topics.objective: Project primary and secondary covariance onto the collision plane (B-plane) to calculate 2D collision probability.
topics.example: Pc = integral_circle(exp(-0.5 * x.T * inv(C) * x) / (2 * pi * sqrt(det(C))))
topics.exercise: Implement a numeric collision probability calculator flagging conjunctions where Pc exceeds the 1e-4 maneuver threshold.

topics.title: Delta-V Collision Avoidance Maneuver (CAM) Optimization
topics.objective: Design optimal along-track and radial thruster burns that reduce collision probability while minimizing fuel consumption.
topics.exercise: Optimize a 0.2 m/s prograde burn 12 hours prior to TCA and verify that secondary conjunction risks remain below threshold.

topics.title: Space Traffic Coordination & Automated Inter-Operator Alerts
topics.objective: Formulate automated coordination workflows with commercial operators and international space tracking registries.
topics.exercise: Write an automated dispatch pipeline alerting orbital operators and logging maneuver telemetry into compliance archives.
